stem: Based on the events at the end of the story “Saturday Surprise,” what will most likely happen in the future?

options.label: A
options.text: Logan will be someone who Jamie sees as being an athletic equal.

options.label: B
options.text: Logan will persuade Jamie to coach more neighborhood kids.

options.label: C
options.text: Logan will organize teams to play at the neighborhood basketball court.

options.label: D
options.text: Logan will play more confidently in front of others.
